Elara Dawn — Album 8.5: Elara Dawn

Fuchsia (The Last Order)

"The color between her purple and the red of what is coming"

[Intro — the battle, arriving mid-chaos] She has seen this field before In her own hands In her own voice In her own order that nobody obeyed

The sight brings her here And she recognizes it the way you recognize a wound in someone else

[Verse 1 — the battle, Elara watching] The companions are falling

She has seen this

She has counted like this She has made the calculation every commander makes before the numbers stop being numbers

She knows the woman at the center of it She has seen her on the floor She has seen her at the window

She did not expect to see her here

Like this

A commander

Not like a sword Not like a blade

Like something sacred being asked to do what sacred things were never built for

And it answers Because she is the last one standing And she has nothing left but the answer

And the light that comes out is not the light that went in

[Chorus] Fuchsia The color between her purple and the red of what is coming Fuchsia The moment the battle became something that outlived the battle She gives the last of what she has to the thing consuming everything around her And what comes back is not light anymore

It is the beginning of the corrupted

Born from the last order of a woman who did not want to fight but fought anyway because her people needed the only thing she had left

[Verse 2 — the companions fall, the field empties, Olan remains] She watches them go

One Then the next Then all the rest

She has stood in this silence before The field after The quiet that belongs to no living person

And then there is one left

And she sees his face

And he is not going to leave on his own

But she has one order

She has always had one order

And this time this time she is going to give it to someone who will obey

[Bridge — Elara, the recognition] She said RUN

She has said it before

She said it in a field like this She said it to people who looked at her and decided where they wanted to die

They did not obey

She has been carrying that In the place where the weight goes permanent

And she watches Adonpra give the last order to Olan

And she watches him obey

And she watches his face as the order takes him somewhere safe

And she understands for the first time

She thought it would be easier

To be obeyed

It is not easier

And the corrupted light born from the last of what she had went out into the world and became everything that came next

And somewhere a woman in a tower carries the same color in her chest

And does not know yet that she is the answer to everything Adonpra held the door for

She has her own field She has her own silence She has her own name she said into the nothing

RUN

Adonpra had a different word but the field was the same

And the light that was corrupted here is the same light that was aimed at her across three hundred years

by the church that was born from the battle she is watching

Until now
